name: Code Style and CI Checks

on:
  pull_request:

concurrency:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code

      - name: Check Rust formatting

          cd src-tauri
          cargo fmt --check

      - name: Run Clippy
        run: |
          cd src-tauri
          cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd src-tauri
          cargo test

  frontend-checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Check formatting
        run: pnpm web:format

  all-checks-pass:
    needs: [backend-checks, frontend-checks]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: All checks passed
        run: echo "All CI checks passed successfully."
